results.name: MulAction.stabilizer
results.source_text:
/-- The stabilizer of an element under an action, i.e. what sends the element to itself.
A subgroup. -/
@[to_additive /-- The stabilizer of an element under an action, i.e. what sends the element to
itself. An additive subgroup. -/]
def stabilizer (a : α) : Subgroup G :=
  { stabilizerSubmonoid G a with
    inv_mem' := fun {m} (ha : m • a = a) => show m⁻¹ • a = a by rw [inv_smul_eq_iff, ha] }
results.docstring:
The stabilizer of an element under an action, i.e. what sends the element to itself.
A subgroup.

results.name: SubMulAction.stabilizer_of_subMul
results.source_text:
/-- Stabilizers in group SubMulAction coincide with stabilizers in the ambient space -/
@[to_additive]
theorem stabilizer_of_subMul {p : SubMulAction R M} (m : p) :
    MulAction.stabilizer R m = MulAction.stabilizer R (m : M) := by
  rw [← Subgroup.toSubmonoid_inj]
  exact stabilizer_of_subMul.submonoid m
results.docstring: Stabilizers in group SubMulAction coincide with stabilizers in the ambient space

results.name: AddAction.stabilizer_orbit_eq
results.source_text:
@[to_additive
  /-- A subgroup containing the stabilizer of `a`
  is the stabilizer of the orbit of `a` under that subgroup -/]
theorem stabilizer_orbit_eq {a : X} {H : Subgroup G} (hH : stabilizer G a ≤ H) :
    stabilizer G (orbit H a) = H := by
results.docstring:
A subgroup containing the stabilizer of `a`
is the stabilizer of the orbit of `a` under that subgroup

results.name: MulAction.stabilizer_orbit_eq
results.source_text:
/-- A subgroup containing the stabilizer of `a`
  is the stabilizer of the orbit of `a` under that subgroup -/
@[to_additive
  /-- A subgroup containing the stabilizer of `a`
  is the stabilizer of the orbit of `a` under that subgroup -/]
theorem stabilizer_orbit_eq {a : X} {H : Subgroup G} (hH : stabilizer G a ≤ H) :
    stabilizer G (orbit H a) = H := by
  ext g
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨b, rfl⟩, h⟩ := hg.symm ▸ mem_orbit_self a
    simp_rw [H.toSubmonoid.smul_def, ← mul_smul, ← mem_stabilizer_iff] at h
    exact (mul_mem_cancel_right b.2).mp (hH h)
  · intro hg
    rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, ← Subgroup.coe_mk H g hg, ← Submonoid.smul_def (S := H.toSubmonoid)]
    apply smul_orbit (G := H)
results.docstring:
A subgroup containing the stabilizer of `a`
is the stabilizer of the orbit of `a` under that subgroup

results.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced
results.source_text:
/-- A function related to the mass term of the potential, used in the stableness
  condition and equivalent to the term `J2` in
  https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184. -/
noncomputable def massTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ :=
  P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) + ∑ μ, P.ξ (Sum.inr μ) * k μ
results.docstring:
A function related to the mass term of the potential, used in the stableness
condition and equivalent to the term `J2` in
https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184.

results.name: RigidBody.small_oscillations_about_equilibrium
results.source_text:
/-- Small oscillations about a stable equilibrium orientation are governed by linearised equations
    obtained by expanding energy to second order in angular displacements. Normal modes and
    frequencies depend on inertia and restoring torques. -/
informal_lemma small_oscillations_about_equilibrium where
  tag := "LL32-SO"
  deps := [``RigidBody]
results.docstring:
Small oscillations about a stable equilibrium orientation are governed by linearised equations
obtained by expanding energy to second order in angular displacements. Normal modes and
frequencies depend on inertia and restoring torques.

results.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_zero_of_quarticTerm_zero_stabilityCounterExample
results.source_text:
lemma massTerm_zero_of_quarticTerm_zero_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet)
    (h : quarticTerm .stabilityCounterExample H = 0) :
    massTerm .stabilityCounterExample H = 0 := by
  rw [quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample_eq_norm_pow_four] at h
  rw [massTerm_stabilityCounterExample]
  have h1 : H.Φ1 = H.Φ2 := by simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h
  simp [← Complex.ofReal_pow, h1]

results.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample
results.source_text:
lemma massTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    massTermReduced .stabilityCounterExample k = k 1 := by
  simp [massTermReduced, PotentialParameters.ξ, Fin.isValue,
    PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample, Fin.sum_univ_three]

results.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_stabilityCounterExample
results.source_text:
lemma massTerm_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    massTerm PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample H =
    2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im := by
  simp [massTerm, PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample]
  rw [← inner_conj_symm H.Φ2 H.Φ1, Complex.conj_im]
  ring_nf

results.name: Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.DenomCondition
results.source_text:
/-- Constraints on denominators which may need to be considered in `field_simp`: no condition,
nonzeroness, or strict positivity. -/
inductive DenomCondition (iM : Q(GroupWithZero $M))
  | none
  | nonzero
  | positive (iM' : Q(PartialOrder $M)) (iM'' : Q(PosMulStrictMono $M))
      (iM''' : Q(PosMulReflectLT $M)) (iM'''' : Q(ZeroLEOneClass $M))
results.docstring:
Constraints on denominators which may need to be considered in `field_simp`: no condition,
nonzeroness, or strict positivity.

results.name: Function.FactorizedRational.divisor
results.source_text:
/--
If `D` is a divisor, then the divisor of the factorized rational function equals `D`.
-/
theorem divisor {U : Set 𝕜} {D : locallyFinsuppWithin U ℤ} (hD : D.support.Finite) :
    MeromorphicOn.divisor (∏ᶠ u, (· - u) ^ D u) U = D := by
  ext z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ U
  <;> simp [(meromorphicNFOn D U).meromorphicOn, hz, meromorphicOrderAt_eq D hD]
results.docstring: If `D` is a divisor, then the divisor of the factorized rational function equals `D`.

results.name: OreLocalization.numeratorHom
results.source_text:
/-- The multiplicative homomorphism from `R` to `R[S⁻¹]`, mapping `r : R` to the
fraction `r /ₒ 1`. -/
@[to_additive /-- The additive homomorphism from `R` to `AddOreLocalization R S`,
  mapping `r : R` to the difference `r -ₒ 0`. -/]
abbrev numeratorHom : R →* R[S⁻¹] where
  toFun r := r /ₒ 1
  map_one' := by with_unfolding_all rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := mul_div_one.symm
results.docstring:
The multiplicative homomorphism from `R` to `R[S⁻¹]`, mapping `r : R` to the
fraction `r /ₒ 1`.

results.name: OreLocalization.numeratorUnit
results.source_text:
/-- The fraction `s /ₒ 1` as a unit in `R[S⁻¹]`, where `s : S`. -/
@[to_additive /-- The difference `s -ₒ 0` as an additive unit. -/]
def numeratorUnit (s : S) : Units R[S⁻¹] where
  val := (s : R) /ₒ 1
  inv := (1 : R) /ₒ s
  val_inv := OreLocalization.mul_inv s 1
  inv_val := OreLocalization.mul_inv 1 s
results.docstring: The fraction `s /ₒ 1` as a unit in `R[S⁻¹]`, where `s : S`.

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.meanEnergyNumerator
results.source_text:
/-- The numerator in the finite-sum expression of the mean energy as a function of the
inverse temperature `b = β`,
namely `∑ i, E i * exp (-b * E i)` (so that `U(b) = meanEnergyNumerator b / Z(b)`). -/
noncomputable def meanEnergyNumerator (b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, 𝓒.energy i * Real.exp (-b * 𝓒.energy i)
results.docstring:
The numerator in the finite-sum expression of the mean energy as a function of the
inverse temperature `b = β`,
namely `∑ i, E i * exp (-b * E i)` (so that `U(b) = meanEnergyNumerator b / Z(b)`).

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.deriv_meanEnergyNumerator
results.source_text:
lemma deriv_meanEnergyNumerator (b : ℝ) :
    deriv 𝓒.meanEnergyNumerator b =
      -∑ i, (𝓒.energy i)^2 * Real.exp (-b * 𝓒.energy i) := by
  unfold meanEnergyNumerator
  have hd : ∀ c : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (-x * c)) (-c * Real.exp (-b * c)) b := by
    intro c
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun x => -x * c) (-c) b := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id b).neg.mul_const c
    simpa [mul_comm] using h.exp
  have h_sum : HasDerivAt (fun x => ∑ i, 𝓒.energy i * Real.exp (-x * 𝓒.energy i))
      (∑ i, -(𝓒.energy i)^2 * Real.exp (-b * 𝓒.energy i)) b := by
    refine HasDerivAt.fun_sum fun i _ => ?_
    simpa [sq, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (hd (𝓒.energy i)).const_mul (𝓒.energy i)
  simpa [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sq, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h_sum.deriv

results.name: EuclideanGroup.OriginStabilizer
results.source_text:
/-- The subgroup of `EuclideanGroup n` whose elements fix the origin
(translation = 0). This is the copy of `O(n)` sitting inside `E(n)`. -/
def OriginStabilizer (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (EuclideanGroup n) where
  carrier := {g | g.translation = 0}
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    show a.translation + a.linear • b.translation = 0
    rw [ha, hb, smul_zero, zero_add]
  one_mem' := rfl
  inv_mem' {a} ha := by
    show a.linear⁻¹ • (-a.translation) = 0
    rw [ha, neg_zero, smul_zero]
results.docstring:
The subgroup of `EuclideanGroup n` whose elements fix the origin
(translation = 0). This is the copy of `O(n)` sitting inside `E(n)`.

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.differentiable_meanEnergyNumerator
results.source_text:
lemma differentiable_meanEnergyNumerator :
    Differentiable ℝ 𝓒.meanEnergyNumerator := by
  unfold meanEnergyNumerator
  refine Differentiable.fun_sum ?_; intro i _; apply Differentiable.const_mul; simp
